data.one_liner: Dart bindings to native system APIs across desktop and mobile
data.what_it_does: Provides unified access to native APIs such as windows, tray icons, menus, displays, keyboard, dialogs, storage, and more, usable from both Flutter and plain Dart.
use_when: Need native window control in a Flutter or Dart app
Need tray icons or system menus
Need access to display information or keyboard events
avoid_when: Target only mobile platforms without desktop support
strengths: Cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux)
Works with both Flutter and plain Dart
weaknesses: Work in progress, breaking changes in recent releases
Requires Flutter 3.50 / Dart 3.14 for full functionality
Experimental runNativeApp() still needs older Dart VM APIs
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package:nativeapi/nativeapi.dart, may need platform permissions for tray or window access
